name: Racial abilities (all races)
summary: In Forever every race has two active and two passive racials. The old Classic weapon-specialisation and resistance passives are gone, several new racials were added, and Priests get extra race-specific spells. Skyborne racials differ by faction.
racials: Dwarf: Stoneform (defensive), Find Treasure (tracking), Artisan's Precision (hit chance), Big Game Hunter (bonus vs beasts)
Gnome: Escape Artist, Eureka! (burst), Expansive Mind (bigger resource pool), Engineering Specialization
Gnome Priest: Confounding Flash (AoE crowd control), Contingency Plan (emergency heal)
Human: Will to Survive (PvP-trinket effect), Perception (see stealth), Ruthless (throughput), The Human Spirit (Spirit; healing for Holy Priests)
Human Priest: Divine Grace (re-shield sooner), Feedback (mana burn on attackers)
Night Elf: Elune's Light (crit burst), Shadowmeld, Quickness (dodge and speed), Wisp Spirit (faster resurrection)
Night Elf Priest: Elune's Grace (defensive), Starshards (extra DoT)
Skyborne High Order: Walk on Air (steerable slow fall), Read Ley Line (mana), Wind Blessed (haste), Elemental Insight (bonus vs elementals)
Orc: Blood Fury (burst), Shatter Curse (remove curses), Command (pet damage), Hardiness (stun resistance)
Tauren: War Stomp (AoE stun), Cultivation (duplicate herbs), Plainsrunning (speed), Endurance (health)
Troll: Berserking (haste burst), Rapid Regeneration, Beast Slaying, Regeneration
Troll Priest: Hex of Weakness, Shadowguard (thorns-like damage)
Undead: Will of the Forsaken, Cannibalize, Underwater Breathing, Touch of the Grave (damage and healing proc)
Undead Priest: Dark Sacrifice (health to mana), Touch of Weakness
Skyborne Windshaper: Walk on Air, Skysight (speed on foot and mounted), Wind Blessed, Elemental Insight
